scope: Fail-closed Gate 1 diagnosis after packaged-control, documented-grid, execution, model-input parity, and surface-force localization tests.

official_reproducibility_gap.packaged_tutorial: The OpenFOAM v2512 airFoil2D tutorial linked from the validation page has 10720 cells, 78 airfoil faces, U=(25.75 3.62 0), nu=1e-5, and no forceCoeffs object.
official_reproducibility_gap.documented_validation: The page describes the NASA 897x257 grid, U=51.4815 m/s, nu=8.58e-6 m2/s, and alpha=0/10/15 degree comparisons.
official_reproducibility_gap.missing_artifact: The linked packaged tutorial is not the case that generated the documented NASA-grid plots, so there is no unchanged public case containing all solver controls to execute.
official_reproducibility_gap.commented_setting: The documentation source contains 'Non-orthogonal correctors: 4' only inside an HTML comment. It is not treated as an active documented setting.

packaged_installation_control.result: Passed unchanged in 308 iterations; not a NASA agreement case.

execution_sensitivity.conclusion: Serial execution did not clear the residual gate or materially change coefficients; 12-rank Scotch decomposition is not the dominant mechanism.

model_and_inflow_parity_ladder.conclusion: Correcting both explicit NASA/OpenFOAM SA parity differences improves drag by only 0.0000223172 and does not clear residual, symmetry, or force-agreement gates.

surface_force_localization.reconstruction_check: Profile integration recovers OpenFOAM final Cd within 4.61e-8 and NASA tabulated Cd within 2.03e-6.

prior_art.source: Ye Zhang, Verification and Validation of OpenFOAM Code, Delft University of Technology dissertation, 2017, section 3.2.1
prior_art.finding: Independent OpenFOAM SST calculations on TMR NACA0012 also report elevated drag and slightly elevated skin friction relative to CFL3D, corroborating that this is not unique to rocket-workbench.

gate_decision.permitted_next_work: A stock-SST run may proceed only as a clearly labelled relative diagnostic, not as a passed validation rung. Alternatively, obtain the unpublished exact OpenFOAM plot-generating case before resuming strict validation.
gate_decision.reason: The public linked case is not the documented case, all explicit parity corrections were tested, and the remaining discrepancy is predominantly pressure drag rather than decomposition or SA inflow/model selection.
